name: Pension for the Construction Workers
nodalDept: BOCW Welfare Board, Labour Department, U.T. Administration of DNH & DD
briefDescription: The scheme provides a monthly pension to eligible registered construction workers after they complete 60 years of age, ensuring welfare and financial security.
descriptionMd: The "Pension for the Construction Workers" scheme is a welfare initiative by the BOCW Welfare Board, Labour Department, U.T. Administration of DNH & DD. It aims to provide financial security to registered construction workers by offering a monthly pension upon reaching 60 years of age. This scheme supports the livelihood of those who have contributed to the construction sector.
benefitsMd: - Monthly pension after completion of 60 years of age.
eligibilityMd:
- Must be an eligible registered member.
- Must have completed 60 years of age.
applicationMd: Contact the nodal department or visit the official scheme portal to apply.
